description: Versioned, Rack-consumable graphcontract conformance fixture sets. Each set is self-contained under testdata/<name>/v<format_version>/ and is exercised by a Go test in this package; a second repository (Rack) may load the same JSON fixtures directly to prove parity without depending on Spool's Go test internals.

fixture_sets.name: schema
fixture_sets.description: Schema TOML normalization and graph/migration/merge candidate validation, valid and invalid, with stable SchemaViolation fixtures.

fixture_sets.name: pack
fixture_sets.description: Immutable pack container format: a valid round-trippable packed object, plus malformed pack streams rejected before any packed object is read - a bad magic header with the stable ErrPackCorrupt error from ValidatePackHeader, and a truncated header with a wrapped io.ReadFull read error from ReadPackHeader.

fixture_sets.name: objects
fixture_sets.description: Canonical Node and Edge encoding covering every PropertyValue kind, minimal (collection-absent) values, invalid property kinds, and non-canonical CBOR rejection, each with its content-derived ObjectID.

fixture_sets.name: commits
fixture_sets.description: Canonical Commit encoding for linear (single-parent) and merge (multi-parent) commits, invalid commits (missing snapshot, empty parent ID), and non-canonical CBOR rejection.
